title: Flat Library Staleness by Filter
dataSources: NINA sequences (`nina:sequence`), NINA autofocus runs (`nina:autofocus`), Ekos scheduler and device events (`ekos:scheduler`, `ekos:device`), PHD2 guiding telemetry (`phd2:guide`), plate solves (`platesolve:run`), filter wheel events (`filterwheel:event`), and flat frames (`flatlib:frame`).
app: Astrophotography session telemetry from N.I.N.A., KStars/Ekos, PHD2, plate-solving tools, ASCOM gear, and filter-wheel controllers sent to Splunk HEC via logs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=flatlib:frame
| search frame_type=flat
| stats latest(_time) as last_seen count as events by filter_name
| eval days_since=round((now()-last_seen)/86400,1)
| sort - days_since
description: Shows which filterss have gone quiet for flat-library refreshes.
value: Stale flats are a common hidden cause of calibration trouble, especially after changing dust motes or optical trains.
implementation: Send flat-library refreshes events to `index=personal` and alert when the gap since the last event grows beyond the expected cadence.
visualization: Table of filterss with time since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It builds which filterss have gone quiet longer than they should for flat-library refreshes.
